observations.fact: Whyte has been managing a hamstring issue for weeks; his minutes in the 46-10 semi-final win over Cronulla were limited as a precaution. Contemporary reporting says he is fit and he is officially named at starting prop for the preliminary final.
observations.decision_effect: Do not treat the reduced semi-final minutes as performance decline; retain workload/hamstring monitoring through late-team checkpoints.
observations.source: news.com.au / Daily Telegraph reporting; official NRL/Roosters team list

observations.fact: Official selection places Toia opposite Farnworth. ABC reports Farnworth leads the NRL with 161 tackle breaks and 75 offloads and leads centres for runs, run metres and post-contact metres; Toia has scored in both Roosters finals matches.
observations.decision_effect: Persist as evidence-supported edge matchup for pre-freeze comparison; no standalone confidence adjustment.
observations.source: ABC News Australia; official NRL team list

audit_note: Raw facts remain separate from MAYHEM inference. No causal injury inference beyond published evidence.
